title: Chasing the ambidextrous moving sofa: how we attacked it, and how we were beaten
summary: Project post-mortem on Romik's ambidextrous sofa (area 1.6449552…). What we proved by hand, where the global bound stayed open, and how a Lean 4 formalisation posted on 2026-10-11 reached the same claim first.

title: The GF(p)-Linear Complexity of Nested Leap-Year Sequences
summary: Linear complexity of F_p-linear combinations of staircase sequences, applied to the Gregorian leap-year count. Exact value 401 for most primes; exceptions at p=3 and p=97.
